pause.title: Pause
pause.breathe.hint: Nothing else needs you right now.
pause.breathe.hintSlow: One more round, a little slower. Let the out-breath be long.
pause.breathe.a11y: Breathing exercise. Follow the words on screen: breathe in, breathe out.
pause.checkin.title: How is it now?
pause.weight.title: What feels heavy?
pause.weight.subtitle: Pick the closest one. You can skip this.
pause.load.title: Pick one. Only one.
pause.load.body: The rest can wait ten minutes.
pause.load.noTasks: You have no open tasks today. Think of one small thing you could do next.
pause.time.title: Short on time isn’t the same as out of time.
pause.time.body: Try saying it this way: “I’m having the thought that I’m running out of time.” Then look around the room for ten seconds.
pause.time.step: Step outside for one minute, if you can.
pause.event.title: Something is coming, and you can meet it in small pieces.
pause.event.body: What is one step you could take today that would make it feel a little lighter?
pause.event.step: Write that step down, then put the rest down for now.
pause.night.title: Nothing needs doing until morning.
pause.night.body: Watching the clock adds worry, not sleep. Turn the screen away and let the night be long.
pause.night.step: Put the phone down when you close this.
pause.unsure.title: That’s fine. You don’t have to name it.
pause.unsure.body: Look around and find five things you can see. Say them slowly, in your head.
pause.unsure.step: Stay with one more slow breath.
pause.end.title: That’s enough for now.
pause.end.body: Pause is always one tap away.
pause.end.private: Your answers here aren’t saved or shared. Only your calm minutes stay on this phone.
pause.help.tight: If it still feels tight, you don’t have to hold it alone. Talking to someone can help.
pause.help.footer: If this feels bigger than stress, talk to someone
pause.help.a11y: Opens a directory of helplines in your browser
pause.hub.subtitle: A calm space for whenever it feels like too much.
pause.hub.quick.title: I need calm now
pause.hub.reassure: No streaks. Miss a day and nothing is lost.
pause.practice.sigh.name: Quick calm
pause.practice.sigh.how: Two breaths in, one long breath out. The fastest way to settle.
pause.practice.coherent.name: Slow breathing
pause.practice.coherent.how: About five and a half breaths a minute, in and out evenly. Steadies the heart.
pause.practice.box.name: Box breathing
pause.practice.box.how: In, hold, out, hold, four seconds each. Steady and focused.
pause.practice.extended.name: Long exhale
pause.practice.extended.how: Four in, six out. The long out-breath is what settles you.
pause.practice.wind.name: Wind down
pause.practice.wind.how: Four in, seven hold, eight out (4-7-8). Slow and heavy, for the evening.
pause.practice.grounding.name: Ground yourself
pause.practice.grounding.how: Name what you can see, feel, hear, smell and taste. Brings you back to now.
pause.ground.tap: Tap each one as you notice it.
